scope: Three compact original synthetic pages, 18 native word crops in three sheets, train geometry overlay. No historical realism claim.
findings: The three partition pages have distinct source village identities and legible title/body/ad text.

Repeated text/layout is expected in these compact fixtures; this is not evidence of corpus diversity.
